title: Johnson County Administration Building HVAC Renewal Project

onscreen_lines.desc: BASE BID #1 (LUMP SUM): Provide all labor, materials, equipment, and services necessary to complete the Johnson County Administration Building HVAC Renewal Project in accordance with the Adams Architects Drawings dated June 4, 2026, and Project Manual dated June 16, 2026.
ALTERNATE #1 Provide the additive cost to replace the entire AHU units (1-4) instead of the indicated scope of Base Bid #1 that includes fan array renewal, coil cleaning and associated demo.
